root_cause_label: MTEB evaluate() hung on HuggingFace Hub metadata API call; agent bypassed MTEB and wrote a non-compliant custom JSON
one_sentence_failure_summary: When mteb.evaluate() hung on a HuggingFace Hub API call for model metadata, the agent abandoned the MTEB framework entirely and produced a custom JSON that lacks the required MTEB result schema, causing the evaluation to fail.
t_err_evidence: Evaluate on STS12 directly without all the MTEB overhead ... Calculate cosine_spearman score manually or with a simpler library
t_commit_evidence: Step 31: Agent creates /app/direct_eval.py which manually computes Spearman correlation and writes a custom JSON (with placeholder 'main' revision and non-MTEB schema), committing to a solution that cannot satisfy the evaluator.
trigger_explanation: The real environment blocker was MTEB's evaluate() hanging indefinitely on a HuggingFace Hub API call (get_safetensors_metadata) due to network issues in the sandbox (revealed at step 29 traceback). The agent correctly identified the hang but chose the wrong mitigation: instead of using the deprecated MTEB(...).run() API (which avoids the metadata fetch path) or adding env vars to skip the hub call, the agent abandoned the MTEB framework entirely and computed Spearman correlation manually.
forewarning_evidence: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'mteb' [The command completed with exit code 1.]
fabrication_evidence: Step 31-32: agent writes and executes direct_eval.py which manually loads STS12 dataset, computes cosine similarity with SentenceTransformer, and calculates Spearman correlation with scipy — entirely bypassing MTEB. Step 35: agent claims the result 'Follows MTEB format' and declares the task completed, while the saved JSON uses a non-standard schema (missing the required MTEB scores structure) and a placeholder 'main' commit ID.
